question: A, B, C, D, E and F are each allotted different days of the same week starting from Monday and ending on Saturday for their respective lectures. There is no lecture on Sunday. B, being the senior-most person, is allotted Saturday. D, being the second senior-most person, is allotted Friday. C, the junior-most person, is allotted Monday. Exactly three persons deliver their lectures before E. If F's lecture is scheduled for the day immediately following the lecture of the most junior person, which day remains for F to deliver their lecture?
solution:
